name: Project file checks
summary: Env file audit, commit message lint and version compare
author: friday-core
description: Quality checks for the files and messages of a code project. It holds 3 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Env file audit: Reads the text of a .env file and reports duplicate keys, malformed lines, empty values, unclosed quotes, placeholder values and keys that hold real-looking secrets. It never repeats a value, only the key name and its length, so the file stays private. Commit message lint: Checks a commit message against the Conventional Commit form this project uses: a known type, a one-word scope, a short summary without a full stop, a blank line before the body, and no attribution trailers or session links. Version compare: Compares version numbers (semver, four-part FRIDAY versions such as 1.1.5.7, Python and Node versions), says which is newer and where they first differ, sorts a list from oldest to newest and checks each against a minimum. Parts are compared as numbers (1.10 is newer than 1.9), missing parts count as 0 and a pre-release (-rc.1) is older than its release.
